title: C++: Simple Regex Engine
description: Implement a simple regex engine supporting ., *, and + operators.

steps.title: Regex Matcher
steps.description: Write a recursive function bool match(string regex, string text) that supports . (any char) and * (zero or more). Test: a*b matches b, a.b matches axb, ab*c matches abc.
hints: If next char is *, try matching 0 or more of preceding char.
Base case: empty regex means text must also be empty.
